summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TAMIS АГРО blog feature. All backend APIs working (30/30 tests passed). Frontend public pages, admin pages, and RichEditor fully functional. Inline contact form submission verified. Only minor non-critical issues found.

minor_issues.issue: content_html present as empty string in list response (spec says should be stripped)
minor_issues.impact: Minimal - empty string vs absent key, no functional impact
minor_issues.note: Due to Pydantic model default value. Backend code does pop() but model adds it back as ''

minor_issues.issue: content_html present as empty string in related posts (spec says should be stripped)
minor_issues.impact: Minimal - empty string vs absent key, no functional impact

ui_bugs.issue: Category button click intercepted by sticky navbar when scrolled
ui_bugs.note: Category is still accessible via other means (category chips on list page). Not blocking.

Frontend: Search filter (URL update, post filtering)

test_methodology.frontend: Playwright browser automation testing public pages, admin pages, and form submissions
test_methodology.admin_auth: Used API token injection into localStorage for reliable admin page testing

performance_notes: Image upload works and files are publicly accessible
Views counter increments correctly on each page view
Reading minutes calculated correctly based on word count
